title: Human-Gated Acceptance Proxy Remediation Loop

source.user_seed: Human-gated acceptance proxy loop: when a required human gate is unavailable, use independent multi-model review plus official standards and competitor evidence only as a fail-closed proxy audit; separate source facts, model dissent, engineering verification, and authority; never convert consensus into human PASS; turn findings into TDD remediation slices, generate a new immutable candidate digest after code changes, rerun affected automated/runtime/visual gates, and stop at qualified-human acceptance.

output_contract.ordering_rule: risk and reuse value before convenience
output_contract.dedupe_rule: merge same seed digest and same routing boundary
output_contract.overlap_rule: prefer existing narrower workflow; avoid broad umbrella steal

gates.warn: weak signal; keep as output fragment or project-scoped candidate
gates.fail: one-off or no durable value; no asset write
gates.blocked: retrieve context or evidence before promotion

gates.pass: local reversible read/write only or exact authority present
gates.warn: future automation mentioned but not authorized
gates.blocked: emit minimal authorization request; do not execute

procedure: Freeze the goal, human-gate contract, candidate digest, non-goals, and evidence boundary.
Collect official sources plus current code, runtime, test, and UI evidence before model consultation.
Run independent reviewers; preserve dissent and separate source facts, inference, recommendations, engineering verification, and authority.
Issue only PASS_AUTOMATED_WITH_LIMITS, HOLD, or BLOCKED from proxy evidence; never emit HUMAN_PASS.
Convert confirmed engineering findings into dependency-ordered RED to GREEN remediation slices.
After any product-byte change, mint a new immutable candidate digest and invalidate stale receipts.

When a UI-test command rebuilds or reinstalls the target app, compute the candidate digest from the actually tested installed app immediately after the run; do not bind its screenshots or logs to a prior standalone build. Preserve that tested bundle or an immutable archive for later human execution.
Rerun every materially affected automated, runtime, API, route, accessibility, and visual gate, including negative cases.
Continue safe local remediation while actionable non-human gaps remain.
Stop at the exact qualified-human or external-authority boundary and attach only a real provenance-bound receipt.
hard_invariants: multi-model consensus is advisory and cannot satisfy a qualified-human gate
competitor research is a benchmark, not proof that the target product was tested
old-digest evidence cannot certify new product bytes
UI-test evidence belongs to the app bytes actually installed and exercised by that run, not to an earlier nominally equivalent build
no push, deploy, publish, credential entry, destructive action, or production mutation without exact authority

continue_while: focused or regression evidence is missing
current-digest independent review has not converged
stop_only_on: qualified-human acceptance is the only remaining gate
external, destructive, publish, credential, or production authority is required
loop_policy.on_new_bytes: mint a new candidate digest and rerun affected evidence; never patch an old receipt into validity
